events.title: CO₂ scrubber efficiency drop
events.body: Partial pressure rising 0.3 kPa above nominal. Maya recommends increasing algae throughput. Chen recommends reducing non-critical loads.

events.title: Micrometeor ping on hull
events.body: Sonar picked a 2mm penetration in sector 7. No breach yet. Patch now costs EVA time. Wait risks cascade.

events.title: Water recycler foam event
events.body: Priya reports surfactant foam in loop C. Food grade or industrial contaminant — test takes six hours.

events.title: Launch day remembrance
events.body: Old crew gather in mess to tell launch stories. New crew roll eyes. The captain has not attended in years.

events.title: Patron of corridor 3
events.body: Someone leaves flowers at a junction where a worker died in year two. No name on the plaque anymore.

events.title: Birth-year lottery for bunks
events.body: Youth deck proposes reallocating bunks by birth year instead of department. Chaos or fairness?

events.title: One med bed, two fevers
events.body: Only one isolation bed is free. An elder with critical skills vs a youth with no record. Both rising.

events.title: Lie on the ration board
events.body: Lee can post false surplus numbers to prevent panic. Hana says the mess will notice the empty trays anyway.

events.title: Leak the captain's health data
events.body: You have seen the med file. Crew morale is fraying on rumors. Publishing would end speculation — and privacy.

events.title: Aurora in the dust lane
events.body: The ship passes a charged particle lane. Observatory reports colors no camera on Earth ever caught.

options.label: Stay on task — no window time

events.title: Fragment of Earth signal
events.body: Comms picks a degraded broadcast — music, then static, then a child laughing. Origin timestamp impossible.

events.title: Accidental bioluminescence
events.body: A cross-contamination in Bay F produces faint blue glow. Safe to eat. Beautiful to watch.

events.title: Captain's address draft
events.body: The captain asks you to review a speech before route vote. Draft A is honest about shortages. Draft B is optimistic fiction.

events.title: Quarterly loss statement
events.body: Ship-wide memo: 2.3% resource loss to spoilage, theft, and 'unexplained'. Captain wants a public figure or a quiet fix.

events.title: Vent smoke — no flame found
events.body: Smoke in corridor 5. No flame sensor trip. Could be electrical — could be someone burning contraband.

events.title: EVA suit leak test fail
events.body: One suit failed pressure test before a hull walk. Two missions queued. One suit.

events.title: Comm static in human voices
events.body: Night shift comms logs phonemes that match no language on board. Elena wants the raw file. Security wants it deleted.

events.title: Greenhouse hum matches void frequency
events.body: Ecology reports bay vibration matching an anomalous comm frequency. Coincidence until it is not.

events.title: Ship cat conspiracy
events.body: Three departments claim a cat lives in the walls. Pest control finds only claw marks on ration crates.

events.title: Unauthorized talent show
events.body: B-crew plans a mess hall talent night during power-saving hours. Hana is thrilled. Chen is not.

events.title: Elder council request
events.body: The oldest hundred ask for a fixed voice in route votes — advisory, not binding. Youth call it a veto in disguise.

events.title: Youth deck slow strike
events.body: Young workers refuse overtime until gym hours improve. Production is not yet affected — tomorrow it will be.

events.title: Silent ration cut
events.body: Stores crossed a threshold you were told not to name aloud. The next week must feel normal while portions shrink.

events.title: No med evac option
events.body: Three critical fevers. Medicine enough for two courses. The ship cannot turn back — that was signed in year one.

events.title: Old cargo manifest
events.body: Raj finds a pre-launch manifest behind a wall panel — items never logged on Qingniao. Including a sealed crate marked PERSONAL.

events.title: Captain's year-one log
events.body: A data chip with the first captain's daily entries. Unfiltered. Some names still serve.

events.title: Draft apology to the ship
events.body: After the last crisis, someone must sign a ship-wide apology. Draft blames systems. Draft blames people.

events.title: Purpose vote
events.body: Science proposes a ship-wide vote: prioritize survival, knowledge, or legacy. Results would bind resource policy.

events.title: Trader offers mystery crate
events.body: Exchange contact offers a crate of Earth-era seeds — unverified viability — for raw and a favor log entry.

events.title: Nitrogen buffer drift
events.body: Atmosphere mix drifting 0.4% off spec. Minor now. Tomas recommends bleed. Priya recommends software patch.

events.title: Fungal filter clog
events.body: Air scrubber filters show fungal growth faster than models. Ecology says normal. Science says new strain.

events.title: Three knocks tradition
events.body: Some crew knock three times before entering closed labs. Superstition from year three outbreak.

events.title: Lucky wrench myth
events.body: Engineering claims one wrench never strips bolts. Manufacturing wants to borrow it for a critical fit.

events.title: Stowaway in stores
events.body: Not a person — a pet gene-mod rabbit in a ration crate. Youth deck knows. Adults debate disposal.

options.label: Youth deck cares for it unofficially

events.title: Recipe war in mess
events.body: Two unofficial recipes for algae cake divide the ship. Hana refuses to pick a winner.

events.title: Emergency tone test backlash
events.body: Monthly alarm test panicked new crew. Next test: warn first or stay realistic?

events.title: Food stock vs route vote
events.body: Mess hall rumor: the next council vote will pick a fast nebula hop while stores show twelve days on tight ration. Families want a food route on the ballot.

events.title: Quorum challenge on last vote
events.body: Two technicians claim they were on B-shift during the last route tally and never heard the lobby window. The captain asks you to validate weighted logs.

events.title: Hull watch alarm — sector 7
events.body: Micrometeor monitor trips again in the sector you chose to watch. Pressure flutter lasts ninety seconds then flatlines. EVA team wants a go/no-go before the next route burn.

events.title: Nebula transit radiation spike
events.body: If the ship holds the current nebula shortcut, shield draw will starve ecology lighting unless engineering steals from manufacturing.

events.title: Anomaly route whispers
events.body: Comms picks patterned static whenever the council lists Anomaly Survey. Cult-adjacent crew call it a sign. Scientists call it instrument bleed.

events.title: Green dwarf flyby scout
events.body: Long-range scan confirms organics on a verdant flyby path — slow segment, but could refill protein stores before the next generation milestone.

events.title: Asteroid belt dust clog
events.body: Micrometeor grit from the last belt segment is clogging external radiator louvers. Engineering wants a slow purge before the next vote cycle.

events.title: Nebula static on comms
events.body: After the nebula shortcut, comms arrays pick up patterned static during council briefings. Some crew swear it sounds like votes being counted before the roll.

events.title: Voyage milestone memorial
events.body: Three route votes in, the mess hall wants a wall of segment names — a living map of where Qingniao has been. Logistics worries it glorifies risky detours.

events.title: Bridge comms leak
events.body: A junior officer overheard lobby tallies on an open channel before the last route vote. Council factions demand to know who was listening.

events.title: Observatory blackout
events.body: Low ship power forces a choice: dim the observatory dome or keep star-map projectors hot for the next council session.

options.label: Split shift — crew votes on hours

events.title: Order fracture before vote
events.body: Morale is brittle and the next route pair is posted. Factions threaten to boycott the weighted roll unless someone guarantees food rations hold through the segment.

events.title: Derelict salvage ethics
events.body: The derelict segment yielded parts — and personal effects tagged unknown crew. Legalists want a memorial; salvagers want the bay cleared for the next vote.

events.title: Green flyby hope spike
events.body: Protein stores jumped after the verdant flyby. Mess hall playlists turn upbeat — veterans warn hope burns fast if the next segment is lean.

events.title: Anomaly segment lockdown
events.body: Two crew report synchronized dreams after the anomaly survey segment. Security wants comms curfew; science wants uninterrupted specimen logging.

events.title: Food promise cracks
events.body: The segment ration pledge is failing — stores dip two days early. Mess hall rumor says the council lied on purpose.

events.title: Quorum challenge revote
events.body: After four route votes, a faction claims the weighted council is gerrymandered. They demand a one-time revote on the last winner with stripped lobby effects.

events.title: Hull stress readout
events.body: Engine telemetry shows micro-stress spikes aligned with recent route changes. Chen wants a slow segment next vote; salvagers want another derelict pass.

events.title: Exchange embargo before vote
events.body: Council factions demand a 48h exchange freeze before the next route roll — no more 'insider' food trades.

events.title: Warehouse muster
events.body: Logistics calls a full muster of crate labels after a disputed audit. Habitation volunteers to count; manufacturing refuses to pause lathes.

events.title: Convoy cheer vs cynicism
events.body: A friendly convoy hails with music on the relay. Half the mess wants a listen-along; half says trading grief isn't a morale fix.

events.title: Parts vs ration emergency
events.body: Engineering needs parts for a recycler patch; Logistics wants the last crate budget for a food convoy trade. Both claim ship survival.

events.title: Lathe noise strike threat
events.body: Quarters near Manufacturing threaten a slowdown unless lathe hours shrink or the hood research completes. Sam says throughput targets won't wait.

events.title: Filter mesh ship-wide alert
events.body: Without scrubber filter mesh, the water loop risks another yellow. Engineering and Manufacturing both claim the other department hoards parts.

events.title: Research vs lathe priority vote
events.body: Science wants power for alloy sintering research; Manufacturing wants the same draw for a three-lathe sprint. Council asks you to break the tie.

events.title: Mess hall audit panic
events.body: Someone posted exchange variance numbers on the galley wall. Families ask if rations are lies. Lee begs for a ship-wide statement.

events.title: Captain budget hearing
events.body: Departments demand a ship-wide hearing on ecology vs manufacturing power shares. The mess hall fills before night cycle.

events.title: Route dissent petition
events.body: Forty-two signatures ask the council to reopen the last route vote after food projections worsened. Navigation warns of morale whiplash.

events.title: HUD blackout drill
events.body: Engineering schedules a 20-minute ship HUD and minimap blackout drill. Crew with night shifts panic anyway.

events.title: Council audit oath
events.body: Lee proposes a public audit oath before the next exchange day. Some councilors call it theater; loaders call it overdue.

events.title: Crew morale pulse survey
events.body: Support runs an anonymous morale pulse. Results show manufacturing noise and audit rumors dominate negative comments.

options.label: Act on top two issues only

events.title: Incubator thaw vote
events.body: Council debates thawing embryos before arrival versus holding them for the next generation. Ecology and Support split the room.

events.title: Whistle rumor on D3
events.body: Mess hall rumor: someone reported cult activity to the captain. Cultists go quiet; uninfected crew watch each other over trays.

events.title: Food locker audit lock
events.body: Logistics locks galley reserve lockers pending audit. Families with children ask for emergency unlock before night cycle.
